text:
maya: FYI Lunaris is going live in LATAM tonight at 23:00 local. They requested latam-south peering + a short header allowlist and a regional QPS bump for the launch window. Account: lunaris-prod.

simon: Cool. Numbers? IPs or header?

maya: They prefer header: X-XCUST: lunaris-main. Target steady 60 QPS, bursts to 100 QPS for 4 hours. Auto-revoke after 4h. Also noted a renewal follow-up if anything slips.

rachel: Prefer header allowlist too. Apply rate_override scoped to route `latam-south` and account only. Schedule auto-revoke and add CRM renewal flag.

simon: Infra payload examples:

```
POST /internal/admin/allowlists
{
  "account": "lunaris-prod",
  "type": "header",
  "header": "X-XCUST",
  "values": ["lunaris-main"],
  "expires_at": "2026-04-02T03:30:00Z",
  "note": "Lunaris LATAM launch - header allowlist, auto-revoke 4h"
}
```

```
POST /internal/admin/rate_overrides
{
  "route": "latam-south",
  "account": "lunaris-prod",
  "qps": 100,
  "duration": "4h",
  "scope": "account",
  "reason": "launch burst window"
}
```

infra-bot: Job queued: job/881122 for header allowlist + rate override (canary -> latam-south-a).

simon: Canary applied to latam-south-a. Monitoring 20m. Alerts: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95_lat > 300ms triggers rollback. Also watch token consumption delta +35%.

maya: Added CRM note and renewal flag. Customer confirmed auto-revoke in DM.

rachel: If canary stable after 20m, push to latam-south-b. I'll prepare a short rollback script: revoke allowlist -> remove rate_override -> notify AM & CS -> revert peering if needed. Schedule revoke job at expiry.

simon: Canary healthy at +25m: p95 140ms, errors 0.4%, token-rate +12%. Pushing to latam-south-b now.

infra-bot: Job/881122 completed: allowlist + rate_override applied to latam-south-a & latam-south-b.

maya: :white_check_mark: Notified customer and AM. Closing after expiry.

(threads end)
